# Plotline

> Plotline is an offline-first, private TV series and movie tracker with exact binge-time analytics, self-hosted Docker support, and multi-platform migration tools (TV Time, Trakt, Letterboxd).

## Overview
Plotline was created following the shutdown of TV Time to provide a durable, 100% self-hosted and offline alternative that guarantees user data ownership. It runs on lightweight Python with SQLite, requires zero cloud dependencies, and features automated scrobbling from Jellyfin and Plex.

## Key Capabilities
- TV show, anime, and movie tracking with season/episode check-ins and rewatch counters.
- Calculation of total binge-watch time formatted in months, days, hours, and minutes.
- iOS TV Time backup extraction (.imazingapp, DioCache.db).
- Multi-platform data import from Letterboxd (CSV), Trakt.tv (JSON), and TV Time.
- Offline metadata caching with hybrid storage mode (stream online vs save offline).
- Achievement milestones and shareable infographic cards ("Plotline Wrapped").
- Local hard drive video file scanner with filename tag cleaning.
- Jellyfin and Plex webhook scrobbling for automated tracking.
- Docker multi-arch support and Progressive Web App (PWA) mobile installation.

## Repository & Links
- Repository: https://github.com/heat-core/plotline
- License: MIT License
- Tech Stack: Python 3.9+, SQLite3 WAL, Vanilla JavaScript, Docker, PWA
